header: Larger portraits, each with a short bio
lead: Two to six people at the largest avatar size, each with a role, a short bio and a linked name. For more people, use a team grid.

people.title: The portrait is a circle
people.role: The avatar at its largest size
people.text: This sets the row apart from the rectangular portraits of Team Grid on the same page.

image.alternative: Portrait of a man in his thirties.

people.title: The name is the link
people.role: One link per person, on the name
people.text: There is no second link below it that repeats the same target.

image.alternative: Portrait of a woman in her twenties.

people.title: Centring moves the whole cell
people.role: Portrait, name, role and bio move together
people.text: The align setting centres the intro too, so no part stays at the start edge.

image.alternative: Portrait of a man in his fifties.
